question.text: The circuit in figure consists of wires at the top and bottom and identical springs as the left and right sides. The wire at the bottom has a mass of $10 \mathrm{~g}$ and is $5 \mathrm{~cm}$ long. The wire is hanging as shown in the figure. The springs stretch $0.5 \mathrm{~cm}$ under the weight of the wire and the circuit has a total resistance of $12 \Omega$. When the lower wire is subjected to a static magnetic field, the springs, stretch an additional $0.3 \mathrm{~cm}$. The magnetic field is
